You meet the weapon close to the hand that holds it, lock your own blade across its path, and wrench the point aside.

Rules

Action
Reaction
Attribute
None (no roll)
Target / range / shape
Self, before a defense roll against an adjacent creature’s melee weapon attack.
Equipment / acquisition
Use an ordinary melee weapon (Bulk 1), supplied on learning if needed.
Type
Skill / Defense

Before the defense roll, use Brawn as your defense attribute and gain 1 Boon to that roll.
